title: Evidence-coding dataset and reproducible D-by-V heatmap for intelligent process-parameter decision-making in polymer injection molding
description: Supporting evidence dataset and reproducible Figure 4 workflow for the review "Intelligent Process Parameter Decision-Making in Polymer Injection Molding: From Initial Setting to In-Process Adaptation". The selected coded ledger contains 158 records: 151 primary-analysis records and seven coded background/conventional-method comparators. Nine recent ungraded context/abstract records are separately listed. The manuscript cites 210 publications. Literature cutoff: 25 October 2026. Bounded WoS updates on 24 and 25 October added no included study; historical queries retain their recorded dates and filters. The English S1, matching CSVs, input data, Python script, pinned dependency, reference heatmap and checksums are supplied in the dataset archive. D and V are paired within the same application; frequencies describe this selected narrative-review evidence set, not field-wide prevalence. No third-party article full texts, private author-review logs, correspondence, permissions or raw database record exports are included. Data and documentation are CC BY 4.0; the Python code is MIT, with the scope specified in LICENSE.txt and code/LICENSE. OpenAI Codex using GPT-6.1 (OpenAI) assisted the author-led script refinement and consistency checks. Scientific coding remains author-confirmed.
